    # Sort spans by timestamp within each trace

    # The most downstream means the last service in the call chain with error_flag True
    def get_most_downstream_faulty_service(call_chain):

    # Count occurrences of each faulty service as most downstream faulty service
    faulty_service_counts = downstream_faulty_services.value_counts().reset_index()
    faulty_service_counts.columns = ['service', 'count']

    # Order faulty services by their position in call chain (most downstream first)
    # Here, we assume the count reflects frequency of being most downstream faulty service
    # So we order by count descending
    faulty_service_ordered = faulty_service_counts
